name: R12.5-11200
body:
### Download
Get the CallToArms-Rx.yy-11200.zip file from Assets and extract in AddOns.

### Options
- `/cta` for command-line options or use the minimap icon to show full UI
- CTA will not automatically join channels, join LookingForGroup and World or Global manually.

Optional FuBar plugin available at [FuBar_CTAFu](https://github.com/Road-block/FuBar_CTAFu)
